subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I am sure that my seeds ______ by next week.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'will grow'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'will grow'.**
 
• In the given sentence **'next week' **is an adverb of **'future simple tense'.**
 
• Other adverbs of **'future simple tense'** are **'tomorrow, today, later today, in five minutes, in two hours, on Monday, on Saturday afternoon, next week/month, this year, etc.'**
 
 
• *Example: Bob will go to the library **tomorrow**.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__ ***I am sure that my seeds **will grow** by next week.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प** 'will grow' **है।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में** 'next week'** **'future simple tense'** का **adverb** है।
 
• 'future simple tense' के अन्य adverbs हैं 'tomorrow, today, later today, in five minutes, in two hours, on Monday, on Saturday afternoon, next week/month, this year, etc.'।
 
 
• *Example: Bob will go to the library **tomorrow**.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3 **है।
